title: L2 Domain Semantics (v1 — descriptive; superseded by v2)
description: M3 schema-first L2 contract (): industry lifecycle/invariants/evidence-requirements/failure-modes that REFINE an L1 capability and trace back to L1 primitives, obligations, or explicit failure modes. A reviewable sidecar artifact, not source syntax. L2 DECLARES evidence requirements; M4 runtime/admission verifies actual evidence. SUPERSEDED (): the machine-emitted executable reduction graph is now the authoritative domain-semantics contract at schemaVersion 2 (same kind neutrino.l2-domain-semantics; l2-domain-semantics-v2.schema.json). This v1 descriptive form is RETAINED for the existing hand-authored artifacts pending migration; it and v2 are the two explicit versions of one contract identity, not overlapping models. See docs/domains/L2_DOMAIN_SEMANTICS.md.

implements.description: The L1 capability or participant role this L2 refines.

coverage.description: partial = simulation fixture that does not yet expand every L1 obligation.

l1.description: The L1 anchors this L2 traces back to.

compensation.description: Reference/description of the compensation pathway (declarative; M4 executes).

concepts.description: Domain concepts L2 introduces. EVERY concept must trace back to an L1 primitive, an L1 obligation, or a declared failure mode.

to.description: An l1.primitives / l1.obligations entry or a failureModes[].name.

participantBranches.description: Per-participant semantic branches; concepts[] reference concept names declared above.

parameters.description: Declared parameter INTERFACES only — symbolic requirements/thresholds. No concrete environment values (those belong to L3 / simulation config).

evidenceRequirements.description: Evidence DECLARED as required. L2 does not verify it — M4 runtime/admission does.

category.description: optional typed proof-intent category (), e.g. channel_verification

proofTags.description: optional proof tags (); concrete transports are an L3/profile concern, never a proof tag

predicate.description: Minimum expression model: EXACTLY ONE of `compare` (structured comparison; right must be a symbolic reference, no magic numbers) or `predicateRef` (named evaluator-backed predicate). Free-form string expressions are rejected as ambiguous.
